checks.label: The native document opens and renders its own bytes
No exchange form is advertised before the human asks for one
The A2A message is pre-filled with the exact selected passage
No A2A request exists before the human's explicit send
A peer whose Agent Card does not advertise the published interface is refused before any message exchange
The refused exchange fetched only the peer's Agent Card — zero message sends
The returned difference is a real oi.a2a-difference/v1, pending admission
The peer answered with an A2A Task
The difference records the exact initiator and counterparty participants
The exchange reached the peer exactly once — one card discovery, one message send
The send speaks the A2A HTTP+JSON v1 binding — media type, version header, ROLE_USER message
The peer received the exact selected passage and nothing else
The difference becomes a generic contribution ingress carrying the a2a-return representation
The A2A return was quarantined under a payload fingerprint, then admitted as its own receiving-side decision
The A2A return's producer is the receiving participant
The return discloses its A2A lineage — the exchange and the task it came back as
The exact peer reply is shown before any decision
Inclusion lands through the owner's revision-checked operation on the exact reviewed basis
The document holds the admitted A2A material with distinct producer and human-review facts
The document source revision advanced through the inclusion
The proposed entry anchor exists in the real document bytes
